about: The alleluia of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

a.g: Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed

ex.w005: Christus is the subject. Pascha nostrum identifies Him as our Passover, and immolatus est means “has been sacrificed”.
